tasks.title: test/ type errors, batch A
tasks.description:
`test/` is not yet covered by `bun run typecheck` and has 38 type errors; this task fixes 19 of them. By file: test/post-task-reviewer.test.ts 11 x TS2345 (nearly all the same argument-type mismatch on `buildPostTaskReviewUserPrompt`'s input object); test/config.test.ts 4 x TS2339 (`maxIterations` accessed on `{ postTask: boolean }` — a leftover of the config field deleted in round 16); test/commands/init.test.ts 2 x TS2352 (`ConfigDefaults` -> `Record<string, unknown>` cast); test/index.test.ts 1 x TS18048 (`args` possibly undefined); test/settle.test.ts 1 x TS2769.

To see the errors, write a TEMPORARY tsconfig that `extends` `./tsconfig.json`, sets `"rootDir": "."` and `"include": ["src", "test"]`, run `tsc --noEmit -p <that file>`, and DELETE it when done — do not modify the real tsconfig.json (task #122 turns the gate on).

Fix the TEST code, not `src/` types, unless a `src/` type is genuinely wrong — if it is, fix it and say so explicitly in the completion notes. Prefer typed helpers or `as unknown as T` casts at mock boundaries over loosening `src/` signatures. Do not add `// @ts-expect-error` or `// @ts-ignore` except as a genuine last resort, with a comment explaining why. `bun test` must stay green. Note that plain `bun run typecheck` cannot yet catch regressions here — that gate arrives in #122.

Practice TDD where it applies: when a fix changes behavior rather than only types, write the failing test first.

Do NOT modify `cairn.json`'s `healthCheck` value and do NOT modify `package.json`'s `build` script — the binary is pinned for this round and the health check is redirected to /tmp/cairn-healthcheck. Do NOT run `./install.sh`. `cairn.json` has an uncommitted user change: stage only the files you changed.
tasks.notes:
# Task #120: test/ type errors, batch A

Fixed all 19 assigned type errors (verified via a temporary tsconfig extending the
real one with `rootDir: "."` and `include: ["src", "test"]`, run through
`tsc --noEmit -p <tmp>`, then deleted — `tsconfig.json` itself was never modified).

## Fixes by file

- **test/post-task-reviewer.test.ts** (11 x TS2345): `buildPostTaskReviewUserPrompt`
  now requires `reviewFilePath` on its input object. Added
  `reviewFilePath: "/p/review.md"` (a plain placeholder, consistent with existing
  literal-path style in the same file) to every call site that was missing it.
  Two calls that already exercised `reviewFilePath` explicitly (with a real
  round-review path) were left untouched.

- **test/config.test.ts** (4 x TS2339): `config.review` is `{ postTask: boolean }`
  (the `maxIterations` field was removed from the type in round 16, though the
  runtime loader still deliberately ignores a legacy `maxIterations` key from
  `cairn.json` — see `src/config.ts` reviewRaw comment). The tests assert this
  legacy-ignore behavior, so I kept them (not deleted) but changed the accessor to
  `(config.review as { maxIterations?: number } | undefined)?.maxIterations` — a
  cast at the assertion boundary, not a loosening of the real `CairnConfig` type.

- **test/commands/init.test.ts** (2 x TS2352): `ConfigDefaults` doesn't overlap
  with `Record<string, unknown>` per TS's structural check. Changed
  `defaults as Record<string, unknown>` to `defaults as unknown as Record<string,
  unknown>` (double-cast through `unknown`, exactly what the compiler suggested)
  at both `reviewMaxIterations` legacy-field assertions.

- **test/index.test.ts** (1 x TS18048): `spawnSpy.mock.calls[0]`'s destructured
  `args` element has an optional element type. Changed `args[0]` to `args?.[0]`
  at the `spawnSync` args assertion in the "edit command opens file with editor"
  test; behavior is identical since the call is asserted to have happened
  immediately above.

- **test/settle.test.ts** (1 x TS2769): the `cases` array for the "gate failures
  return done with the matching reason" test had `reason: string`, which doesn't
  narrow to the `Verdict` union's `DoneReason` literal type. Imported `DoneReason`
  from `../src/settle` and typed the array as
  `Array<{ reason: DoneReason; ... }>`.

## Scope notes

- No `src/` types were changed — all 19 fixes are test-code-only, matching the
  task's file list exactly (`tsconfig.json` was read but not modified; the
  temporary probe tsconfig was deleted before finishing).
- No `// @ts-expect-error` / `// @ts-ignore` added.
- No behavior changes were made to any fix (only type-level casts/annotations/
  argument additions), so no new failing-test-first TDD cycle applied here —
  every fix is a type-only correction at a test/mock boundary or an added
  required field with a placeholder value that doesn't affect assertions.
- Verified remaining test/ errors (19, in `test/commands/run.test.ts` and
  `test/stream-filter.test.ts`) are untouched and out of scope for this task —
  confirmed via the temp tsconfig probe before and after my edits: 38 total type
  errors before, 19 remaining after, all in those two other files (reserved for
  future batches / task #122's gate).
- `bun run typecheck` (src-only, unaffected by this task) and `bun test` both
  pass clean: 1216 pass, 0 fail.
- Did not touch `cairn.json`'s `healthCheck` or `package.json`'s `build` script
  (round-17 binary pin in effect). `cairn.json` had a pre-existing uncommitted
  user change; only the 5 test files I actually edited were staged for commit.

CANARY-17

tasks.title: Headless reviewer: --disallowedTools closes the same --output hole
tasks.description:
`cairn run`'s headless reviewer is contained only by `--allowedTools` prefix rules (`Bash(git diff:*)` etc.), which cannot exclude an argument — so it can still run `git diff --output=<file>` (CLAUDE.md calls this the "remaining headless gap").

A probe run during planning CONFIRMED both the hole and the fix: with `--allowedTools "Bash(git log:*)"` and no deny, `git log --output=/tmp/f` ran and wrote the file; adding `Bash(*--output*)` blocked both the plain form and the `--output${X}=` variable form; adding `Bash(*$*)` plus the quote patterns also blocked the split-quoting form `git log --out"put"=/tmp/f`. `git log --oneline -3` still ran (no false positives).

Add a `--disallowedTools` argument to the reviewer spawn in `spawnPostTaskReviewer` (src/post-task-reviewer.ts) carrying that validated list — `Bash(*--output*)`, `Bash(*--out*)`, `Bash(*$*)` and the quote patterns (`Bash(*")` and the single-quote equivalent) — and define the list as an exported constant BESIDE `GIT_INSPECTION_RULES` in src/claude-settings.ts, so the headless deny rules and the hook's parsed checks stay visibly paired even though they can't be made identical.

Watch the pattern syntax: the probe found `Bash(git log:* --output*)` matches nothing (the `:` prefix form does not combine with a trailing wildcard), so use the forms listed above verbatim.

Test (TDD — write the failing test first, watch it fail, then make it pass): assert the spawn is invoked with `--disallowedTools` followed by the expected value — use the existing injected `spawn` dependency. NEVER spawn a real reviewer against this repo, and do not try to re-probe Claude Code's matching behavior from a unit test.

Known and accepted limit, to document rather than solve: deny patterns match raw command text while the hook parses the command, so /cairn-run remains the stronger layer — this is defense in depth against a trusted agent, not a sandbox.

NEVER run `cairn round …`, `cairn hook …`, `cairn init`, or `bun src/index.ts round|hook|init …` against this repository's root. Exercise these code paths only in temp directories created with `fs.mkdtempSync`.

Do NOT modify `cairn.json`'s `healthCheck` value and do NOT modify `package.json`'s `build` script — the binary is pinned for this round and the health check is redirected to /tmp/cairn-healthcheck. Do NOT run `./install.sh`. `cairn.json` has an uncommitted user change: stage only the files you changed.

tasks.title: test/ type errors, batch B, then turn the gate on
tasks.description:
Fix the remaining 19 `test/` type errors and then extend the type-check gate to `test/`. By file: test/commands/run.test.ts 14 errors (TS2322 mock type mismatches — `Mock<…>` vs `(...args: unknown[]) => void`, archive-mock return types — plus TS2769 overload failures); test/stream-filter.test.ts 5 errors (TS2741 `fetch` mocks missing `preconnect`, one TS2322).

Then update tsconfig.json: add `"test"` to `include`, and change or remove `"rootDir": "src"` (set `"."` or delete it — it currently rejects files outside `src/`). `bun build --compile` ignores `rootDir`/`outDir`, so this cannot affect the build; leave `outDir` alone.

Finally, run `bun run typecheck` and fix any type errors introduced by the new tests from #117–#121 — the gate must exit 0 with `test/` included.

Same rules as batch A: fix test code rather than loosening `src/` signatures, prefer typed helpers or `as unknown as T` at mock boundaries, and avoid `@ts-expect-error`/`@ts-ignore` except as a commented last resort. `bun test` must stay green.

DO NOT modify `package.json`'s `build` script or `cairn.json`'s `healthCheck` while you are in these config files — the binary is pinned for this round and the health check is redirected to /tmp/cairn-healthcheck. Do NOT run `./install.sh`. `cairn.json` has an uncommitted user change: stage only the files you changed.

tasks.title: Docs: CLAUDE.md and README.md for the round-17 changes
tasks.description:
Update the docs to match what this round shipped. Docs only — no code changes.

In CLAUDE.md:
1. Development — `bun run typecheck` now covers `src/` AND `test/`; remove the paragraph about `test/`'s ~43 pre-existing type errors being deferred.
2. Enforcement under /cairn-run — the reviewer's Bash scope now denies any command containing `$` (shell expansion, subsuming `$(`, `${…}`, `$VAR`, `$'…'`), with the exact-token `--output` check kept as a second layer; and the hook now resolves the project by walking up from the tool call's `cwd`, ignoring `CAIRN_PROJECT_ROOT`, falling back to the env var only when the payload has no usable `cwd` (including for the error-log path).
3. Replace the "Remaining headless gap" paragraph: the headless reviewer now spawns with `--disallowedTools`, a probe established that deny wildcards DO match an argument mid-command, and the residual limit is that deny patterns match raw text while the hook parses the command — so the hook stays the stronger layer.
4. Per-project data layout — `cairn init` now adds missing entries to an existing `.cairn/.gitignore` (append-only, never reorders or removes).
5. Run state — merge the two duplicated bullets ("Picking records the sha under the lock" and "Orphan pruning") into the bullets above them that already say the same thing.

In README.md: matching updates to the reviewer-containment line (~line 167) and the `.gitignore` / `cairn init` lines (~lines 105, 381).

Do NOT modify `cairn.json`'s `healthCheck` value and do NOT modify `package.json`'s `build` script — the binary is pinned for this round and the health check is redirected to /tmp/cairn-healthcheck. Do NOT run `./install.sh`. `cairn.json` has an uncommitted user change: stage only the files you changed.
